turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your afternoon going in Phoenix before your night shift?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! It's going well, just trying to wake up. I'm currently sipping on some iced, slow-brewed coffee that I let steep overnight. I really needed that cool caffeine kick.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds perfect for a warm Phoenix afternoon. Are you heading out to the hospital soon?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I'm actually about to leave. I decided to hail a ride on an app instead of driving myself today. It's nice because I can just relax in the back and listen to a really funny comedy podcast where the hosts just banter.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a nice, stress-free way to start your shift! Do you have some dinner ready to take with you, or will you have to grab something at the hospital?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually have some of last night's dinner that I packed into a container, so I'll just heat that up when I get a break.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice, taking your own food is always a great option. Speaking of, did you and Tom get to do any salsa dancing this week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We did! We went out on Tuesday night. It was so much fun, though my feet are still a bit tired today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's great you both make time for that! How is Tom doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's doing really well, thanks for asking. He's been busy, but we always find time to catch up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful. Well, I hope your ride goes smoothly and you have a manageable shift tonight at the ER!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'll talk to you tomorrow after I get some sleep.
